### MAP-0043603515

- mapping source: [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:1-36](../../../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts#L1-L36)
- symbol: TradingGit imports and DERIVATIVE_SECTYPES
- unique targetChapters: 3, 9, 10, 19
- id: MAP-0043603515
- assessment: designed
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:1-36: 直接导入 crypto、Decimal、IBKR Contract/Order/sentinels、OrderHelper，并在类中硬编码 DERIVATIVE_SECTYPES。
- currentBehavior: TradingGit 同时负责 broker SDK-shaped operation、sentinel redaction、交易日志和 derivative simulation；同一 class 的 imports 证明模块边界混合。
- problem: domain/Git authority 依赖具体 IBKR SDK，使 broker-specific defaults 和 market instrument rules 无法通过 broker-spi/market boundaries 验证或替换；其他 adapter 只能被迫伪装 Contract/Order。
- targetModel: The target keeps UTA semantic units such as Instrument, Order and Position facts, while each provider declares its own leaf schemas and native binding extensions. Catalog owns canonical identity, adapters decode native contracts, and market/accounting owns valuation facts; none is a universal SDK or global action map. Git audit uses redacted domain views.
- pureTransitions:
  - resolveInstrument(nativeOrPublicInput, facts) -&gt; Result&lt;InstrumentId, InstrumentResolutionFailure&gt;：display symbol 与 canonical identity 分离。
  - compileNative(action, adapterFacts) -&gt; Result&lt;SerializableNativePlanRecord, PlanVersionUnsupported&gt;：只在 adapter interpreter 内构造 SDK object。
  - Closure rule: resolveCanonicalSelector(selector, catalog) -&gt; InstrumentDescriptor | InstrumentNotFound | IdentityCollision; bindNativeContract(descriptor, adapter) is separate.
- effectBoundary: SDK connection/IO stays inside the selected provider adapter or bridge; the UTA kernel receives only the declared leaf codec/handle and does not depend on IBKR or any universal SDK.
- durability: journal 存 domain action/native plan record version，不存 SDK instances；plan digest 覆盖可执行重建资料和 capability fingerprint。
- errors:
  - InstrumentResolutionFailure：拒绝 symbol 猜测。
  - PlanVersionUnsupported：旧计划不能被新 SDK 无声重解释。
  - NativeDecodeFailure：adapter 原始 payload 不进入 journal。
  - Closure rule: InstrumentNotFound
  - Closure rule: IdentityCollision
  - Closure rule: CapabilityUnavailable
- preservedBehavior:
  - IBKR sentinel 在 adapter boundary 被清理，public order summaries 仍可用。
  - derivative-aware simulation 行为保留在 market service，而非删除业务能力。
- replacementSteps:
  - 删除 TradingGit 对 @traderalice/ibkr/OrderHelper 的 imports。
  - 迁移 SDK conversion 到具体 broker interpreter，迁移 DERIVATIVE_SECTYPES 规则到 instrument metadata/valuation。
  - 让旧 callers 通过 application services 而非 TradingGit 直接访问。
- verificationCases:
  - 同一 domain PlaceOrder 可由 Mock/IBKR adapter 各自编译，SDK 类型不跨 kernel boundary。
  - adapter 未知 sentinel/contract identity 时 prepare 失败而不是使用 display symbol。
  - Closure rule: A native contract lookup cannot create a new canonical instrument or silently choose between duplicate mappings; the action remains unprepared until mapping evidence is available.
- openQuestions: —
- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: TradingGit.ts 的 IBKR imports/DERIVATIVE_SECTYPES 是实际 source coupling，不是目标统一 SDK；目标将 native lookup/redaction 放 provider adapter，semantic units 在 UTA boundary。
- contractAnchors:
  - [K01](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K02](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K03](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K07](../composition-contract.md)

- review: accepted — TradingGit.ts:1-36 imports IBKR Contract/Order/sentinels and hard-codes DERIVATIVE_SECTYPES inside TradingGit; the final cutover confines SDK decoding to broker adapters and moves instrument/valuation facts into named domain services. Closure resolution: Catalog is canonical for selectors; adapters provide only native binding evidence and cannot mint ambiguous IDs.

### MAP-0CBE2FB0D9

- mapping source: [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:54-59](../../../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts#L54-L59)
- symbol: isPendingHashConflict
- unique targetChapters: 4, 5, 8, 12, 19
- id: MAP-0CBE2FB0D9
- assessment: designed
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:54-59: isPendingHashConflict 接受 unknown，按 instanceof 或任意 object 的 code/name 字符串判断。
- currentBehavior: 错误来源被丢失；任何恰好带 code=PENDING_HASH_CONFLICT 或 name=PendingHashConflictError 的 object 都会被当成并发冲突。
- problem: string classification 可误报并允许任意 unknown 穿透；它无法处理 typed storage/dispatch/approval failures，也阻止 exhaustive protocol mapping。
- targetModel: 以 TransactionFailure tagged union 和 Schema decoder 代替 predicate。Effect.catchTag/Pattern matching 只处理明确 variant；未知外部 error 在 adapter/transport boundary 解码为 ProtocolFailure 或 Defect，不能伪造 VersionConflict。 Contract alignment: Unknown external errors are not promoted to a transaction variant; the provider boundary reports its declared error schema or a protocol defect.
- pureTransitions:
  - decodeFailure(unknown) -&gt; Result&lt;TransactionFailure, ProtocolFailure | Defect&gt;：外部 error-like payload 只有通过 schema decoder 才能成为 ProtocolFailure/TransactionFailure；不可解码的未知值只能成为边界诊断 Defect，不能伪造成业务 failure。
  - handleFailure(failure) -&gt; Retry|Reprepare|Observe|OperatorRequired：由 variant 和 state 决定，不读 name/message。
- effectBoundary: transport 只解码错误 payload；application/kernel 只使用 typed failure；logger 对每 variant 使用 redacted encoder。
- durability: failure variant 与 command receipt/error reference 可持久化；unknown decoder error 不写成业务 rejection，保留 raw digest 诊断。
- errors:
  - ProtocolFailure({ schemaVersion, detail })：外部错误未识别。
  - TransactionFailure.VersionConflict：标准 CAS 冲突。
  - Defect：不可能的内部 invariant，交监督策略处理。
- preservedBehavior:
  - HTTP 409 仍可用于 VersionConflict，但根据 tag 而非字符串。
  - 其他业务失败不会被误分类为并发冲突。
- replacementSteps:
  - 删除 isPendingHashConflict 及所有 name/code 检测。
  - 在 routes/application 使用 exhaustive typed mapper。
  - 增加伪造 error-like object 的负例，确保不获 409 conflict。
- verificationCases:
  - unknown object {name:'PendingHashConflictError'} 到错误 mapper：ProtocolFailure/500 policy，而不是 VersionConflict。
  - 真实 VersionConflict variant 映射 409，并携带 expected/actual 版本。
- openQuestions: —
- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: isPendingHashConflict 通过 name/code 猜测任意 unknown；目标在 transport/provider boundary 解码具名失败，未知值不能变成 VersionConflict 或其他交易语义。
- contractAnchors:
  - [K03](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K07](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K11](../composition-contract.md)
- review: accepted — isPendingHashConflict:54-59 accepts instanceof or arbitrary code/name objects, so unrelated errors can become conflicts; the repaired decoder requires a runtime schema and classifies undecodable external values as ProtocolFailure/Defect, never VersionConflict.

### MAP-0D11241FE8

- mapping source: [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git-persistence.ts:18-23](../../../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git-persistence.ts#L18-L23)
- symbol: LEGACY_GIT_PATHS
- unique targetChapters: 6, 7, 11, 16, 17, 19
- id: MAP-0D11241FE8
- assessment: designed
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/git-persistence.ts:18-23: LEGACY_GIT_PATHS 将 bybit-main/alpaca-paper/alpaca-live 指向旧 crypto-trading/securities-trading 文件，并注明待删除。
- currentBehavior: 初始化时 primary 文件失败会按 accountId 选择旧路径；多个 Alpaca id 共享 securities-trading/commit.json。路径 fallback 是运行时恢复逻辑，并且无法告诉调用者 primary 是缺失、损坏、无权限还是旧数据。
- problem: 多份 JSON authority 使恢复结果依赖路径优先级；共享旧文件还可能混入多个 account 的历史。silent fallback 会把 corruption 伪装成新账户，或把没有 dispatch identity 的旧 commit 当成可继续执行的交易。
- targetModel: 迁移边界定义 LegacyImportRecord{sourcePath, accountId, discoveredScope, sourceDigest, importedAt, legacyCommitIdentity, evidenceClass: LegacyEvidence|OperatorRequired}。导入器逐条解码旧 payload，能安全映射的只写 GitAudit/历史 observation；缺少 dispatch identity、scope 或 remote evidence 的记录禁止生成可执行 job。导入完成后 authority 只查 SQLite；没有凭据或 scope 的 keyless/只读来源只能产生 LegacyEvidence/PreparationPreview，不能生成 Prepared/Approved、EffectJob 或 dispatch。 Closure rule: Legacy import records retain source digest and account evidence; if one source contains multiple account scopes or cannot prove scope, import as OperatorRequired and do not assign transaction authority. Contract alignment: Legacy import is historical evidence and never a capability declaration or an execution source.
- pureTransitions:
  - classifyLegacyCommit(decodedLegacy) -&gt; LegacyImportDecision：完整且可映射的 commit 变为 audit event；含未知 operation、缺 account scope 或可能已派发但无 identity 的记录变为 OperatorRequired。
  - dedupeLegacySources(records) -&gt; ordered unique records：以 sourceDigest+recordIndex+legacy hash（不含 sourcePath）去重，并把每个发现路径保留为 provenance；同一内容被 primary/legacy 两条路径读到时只产生一份 audit/event。
  - Closure rule: classifyLegacyScope(records) -&gt; ScopedImport | LegacyAuthorityAmbiguous | OperatorRequired.
- effectBoundary: 一次性 migrator 负责读取各旧路径、写事务和 migration ledger；之后 startup 禁止 fallback。legacy 文件只读作证据，任何 adapter dispatch/compensation 不能直接消费它。
- durability: LegacyImportLedger 与导入事件在 SQLite transaction 中写入，包含 source digest、schema version、mapping result 和 rejection reason；重复启动按 sourceDigest 幂等。迁移异常保留记录并停止相关 scope，不回退到另一旧路径。 Closure rule: Import provenance and operator disposition are durable before any projection; unresolved records remain immutable LegacyEvidence.
- errors:
  - LegacyShapeInvalid({ path, recordIndex, detail })：该记录进入 OperatorRequired，迁移继续/停止策略由 migration policy 明确，不能静默跳过。
  - LegacyAuthorityAmbiguous({ accountIds, path })：阻断自动执行并要求人工归属。
  - LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing({ legacyHash })：可保留只读审计，但进入 RecoveryRequired/OperatorRequired，不重发。
  - Closure rule: LegacyAuthorityAmbiguous
  - Closure rule: OperatorRequired
- preservedBehavior:
  - 旧提交仍可在 Git audit 中被检索，且来源路径和迁移时间可追溯。
  - 已证明纯审计的 order/fill 文本可保留；未证明的状态只标记 evidence，不升级为 Confirmed。
- replacementSteps:
  - 新增 one-shot importer 与 migration ledger；先处理共享 Alpaca 文件的 account 归属，再导入。
  - 完成每个配置 account 的迁移 receipt 后删除 LEGACY_GIT_PATHS 和 fallback 分支。
  - 让 manager 只在 journal startup result 为 Ready 时构造 application services；移除路径选择与 broker reconnect 的耦合。
- verificationCases:
  - primary 缺失但 legacy 文件损坏：返回 LegacyShapeInvalid/CorruptJournal，不继续读取另一旧路径伪装成空状态。
  - 同一旧文件被两次启动导入：sourceDigest 唯一约束保证一份 audit/event，且不能创建第二个 execution job。
  - Closure rule: A mixed-account legacy fixture remains read-only and cannot create a PreparedPlan, dispatch job or recovery owner.
- openQuestions:
  - 迁移前必须枚举历史文件中的 account scope；若单文件包含多个 account、scope 缺失或归属无法证明，整条记录保留 provenance 并按 OperatorRequired/LegacyAuthorityAmbiguous 只读处理，不分配交易 authority。
- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: LEGACY_GIT_PATHS 的共享 Alpaca 文件和 fallback 证实了 authority 歧义；新目标只能把旧记录作为带 provenance 的 LegacyEvidence，不能把迁移猜测升级为可执行计划。
- contractAnchors:
  - [K03](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K08](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K11](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K12](../composition-contract.md)
- review: accepted — LEGACY_GIT_PATHS:18-23 creates competing primary/legacy authorities; the repaired importer uses source digest plus record identity (not discovery path), retains provenance, and maps missing scope/remote evidence to LegacyEvidence or OperatorRequired. Closure resolution: mixed-account membership remains empirical; unproven scope is retained as LegacyAuthorityAmbiguous/OperatorRequired and cannot enter execution.
- design: [design.md](design.md)

### MAP-1A49DD8DEE

- mapping source: [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:291-387](../../../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts#L291-L387)
- symbol: TradingGit order-state projection tests
- unique targetChapters: 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 12, 17, 18, 20
- id: MAP-1A49DD8DEE
- assessment: designed
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:291-387: success callback 按 orderState 映射 filled/cancelled/rejected/submitted；Inactive 虽 status=rejected 仍进入 submitted。
- currentBehavior: OperationResult.success 决定数组归属，status 另由 Filled/Cancelled/Inactive/default 映射；因此 success=true + status=rejected 是可表示状态，submitted 不代表 fill。
- problem: legacy submitted/filled/cancelled/rejected 同时混合 dispatch success、venue order state、transaction terminality，允许互相矛盾；没有 Ack、Observation、CommitCriterion 的分层。
- targetModel: 每个声明的 scoped effect leaf 有 ActionAck、RemoteObservation、StepSettlement；ExecutionView 显式显示 dispatchState、remoteState、criterionState 和 per-step outcome。OrderStatus ADT 至少 PendingSubmit/Working/PartiallyFilled/Filled/Cancelled/Rejected/Unknown；Ack 不能直接成为 Filled，TransactionCommitted 只能由 immutable criterion evaluator 产生。Keyless/read-only views may render these states but cannot create ActionAck or dispatch records。 Closure rule: Commit criterion is required in PreparedPlan or PolicyProfile; new requests have no implicit per-action default. LegacyRequestAcceptance may preserve old ack-oriented behavior only, and its acknowledgement does not claim cancellation completed or modification observed. Effect-confirmed cancellation/amendment use OrderCancellationObserved or OrderTermsObserved with correlated order/terms and fresh observation evidence. Close uses an explicit TargetExposureReached target/tolerance selected at prepare. Contract alignment: Criterion is selected for the declared effect leaf and plan, while provider-specific states stay in its exact observation schema; no global status switch is required.
- pureTransitions:
  - decodeDispatchAck(actionTag, decodedNative) -&gt; ActionAck&lt;Tag&gt; | BrokerRejected&lt;Tag&gt; | ProtocolViolation；decodeOrderObservation(actionTag, decodedNative) -&gt; Observation&lt;Tag&gt;：Filled/Cancelled/Working 等 exhaustive，未知 native status 为 ProtocolViolation/Unknown。
  - evaluateCriterion(criterion, observations) -&gt; Satisfied|Pending|Violated|Indeterminate：Ack accepted 不能满足 FullyFilled。
  - Closure rule: selectCommitCriterion(preparedPlan, policyProfile) -&gt; ExplicitCriterion | CriterionRequired; evaluateCriterion uses normalized evidence and never status strings or callback result names.
- effectBoundary: adapter 解码 order state；journal writer 存 receipt/observation；projection formatter 将 typed states 映射到 UI labels。 Closure rule: Criterion evaluation is pure over normalized evidence; broker acknowledgement is an input fact and never silently mutates cancellation, amendment or fill lifecycle.
- durability: Observation identity+version 去重，fill cumulative/delta 用 Decimal string 写入；execution projection 与 event 同事务更新，audit projection 异步。
- errors:
  - VenueRejected({ reason })：remote 终态拒绝。
  - StillWorking({ nativeStatus })：保持执行/继续 observe。
  - CriterionIndeterminate({ missingEvidence })：不提交 transaction，进入 Reconciling。
  - Closure rule: CriterionRequired
  - Closure rule: CriterionIndeterminate
  - Closure rule: CriterionViolated
- preservedBehavior:
  - 订单刚被 venue 接受但仍工作时仍显示 submitted/working 语义；不要把 accepted 改成 filled。

- assessment: designed

  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:135-173: push 逐 operation 执行、读取 state、返回 submitted，并在成功 callback 后清理 staging。
- currentBehavior: 测试只覆盖一个内存对象中 executeOperation 全部 resolve 的顺序；旧 push 在 broker callback 之前没有 durable intent/job，onCommit 失败时状态清理不发生。
- problem: remote mutation 先于 authority journal；partial group、Ack≠fill、network unknown、lease expiry、重启和 compensation 没有可表达状态。Main 的 node 探针已观察 snapshot failure 时 dispatch=1/pending retained/commits=0、retry dispatch=2/commit=1；onCommit failure 时 dispatch=1/pending retained/commits=1、retry dispatch=2/commits=2。该行为不是 broker crash-recovery proof，却确认了旧 retry 会重复 mutation。
- targetModel: Prepare 只提交 revision-scoped PreparedConflictLocks；Approve/queue 才原子写 TransactionApproved、StepQueued/DispatchPlanned、ExecutionReservation、EffectJob 和 receipt。Scheduler claim 后 CAS 写 DispatchStarted(epoch) 才调用选中的 provider effect handle，且每行带 AccountScope/step identity。结果按 Ack/RemoteOutcome&lt;ActionTag&gt; durable 写入，FailurePolicy 是 digest-bound ADT：旧 batch known rejection 可翻译 ContinueOnKnownRejection；Unknown 暂停后续 step。 Closure rule: Dispatch idempotency is capability-gated per venue; absent horizon/identity evidence yields ObserveUnknown/RecoveryRequired and no automatic repeat/cancel. Contract alignment: withTransaction is applied only to a capability that declares a trading effect; read/stream handlers remain outside WAL, approval, and compensation.
- pureTransitions:
  - executeOutcome(state, dispatchId, outcome) -&gt; Accepted(events,intents) | Rejected(InvalidTransition)：Ack 只记录 venue receipt，Confirmed/Rejected/Unknown 由 observation/criterion 决定状态。
  - classifyBatchProgress(policy, stepOutcomes) -&gt; Continue | SuspendUnknown | Abort | CommitCriterionPending：不让 scheduler catch 行为隐式决定 stop/continue。
  - Closure rule: classifyDispatchRetry(nativeConformance, attempt) -&gt; RetryEligible | ObserveUnknown | RecoveryRequired.
- effectBoundary: JournalWriter 是唯一 authority mutation；Scheduler/selected provider leaf handles are the broker IO boundary；ProjectionStore 只读已提交事件。dispatch、observe、compensate 各自是 typed Effect service，不再接受 raw executeOperation callback。 Closure rule: The scheduler may enqueue Observe jobs after possible-send outcomes, but only an adapter conformance record can authorize another mutation.
- durability: DispatchStarted、attempt、epoch、idempotency identity 必须先 commit；Ack/Rejected/Unknown 与 RemoteObservation 去重后再创建后继 job。PreparedConflictLocks 与 execution reservations 分阶段管理；RecoveryRequired 保留 durable RecoveryCase owner 和所有冲突 keys，不能只因状态标签而释放。 Closure rule: Persist attempt identity, native evidence gaps, lease epoch and RecoveryCase ownership so restart cannot turn Unknown into a retryable failure.
- errors:
  - BrokerRejected({ dispatchId, rejection })：记录已知失败，按 prepared FailurePolicy 继续/终止。
  - OutcomeUnknown({ dispatchId, evidence })：进入 Reconciling，挂起后续 batch，不重发。
  - ProjectionFailure({ sequence })：不改变 dispatch/transaction 状态，只标 projection lag。
  - Closure rule: ObserveUnknown
  - Closure rule: RecoveryRequired
  - Closure rule: NativeGuaranteeUnproven
- preservedBehavior:
  - 批量中已知 rejected operation 仍可按旧 ContinueOnKnownRejection 语义结算，且每 step outcome 独立可见。
  - 成功提交后 staging/proposal 可清理，但清理不是 broker completion criterion。
- replacementSteps:
  - 删除 push/executePush 的 broker loop，新增 Approve/Queue command 与 durable worker。
  - 将旧 submitted/rejected arrays 改为 TransactionResult per-step outcomes；保留 user-facing projection adapter。
  - 加入七个 crash cuts、unknown observe 和 recovery-case ownership 的 vertical tests。
- verificationCases:
  - 在 DispatchStarted commit 后 kill worker、broker ledger 已接受但 UTA 无 ack：重启只创建 Observe job，同 dispatchId 不得第二次 send。
  - 第一 step known rejected 且 FailurePolicy=ContinueOnKnownRejection、第二 step working：第二步可执行；若第二步 Unknown，第三步不派发直到分类。

- problem: 对象级 mutex 既不能跨进程，也把独立 instrument/account 的工作不必要地串行化；它不能表达 lease owner/epoch、过期 worker fencing 或 RecoveryRequired 的 key 持有。
- targetModel: 每个 PreparedStep 编译 NonEmpty ConflictKey 集合（Account、SubAccount、Instrument、Order、Exposure 等层级）；TransactionPrepared 原子取得 revision-scoped PreparedConflictLocks，Approve/claim 才取得 accepted-execution reservations。EffectJob 使用 Ready/Leased(owner,epoch,deadline)/Completed/Failed。RecoveryCase 继续持有相关 keys，直到 operator transfer/terminal event；keyless/read-only scope cannot acquire either lock class for mutation。 Closure rule: ConflictKey hierarchy is fixed: Account(scope) conflicts with its Order(scope, order) and Exposure(scope, instrument, positionBucket) children; same Exposure or Order conflicts with itself; Connection(connectionId) is independent unless explicitly shared. Acquire all keys atomically. Contract alignment: Conflict keys and leases fence durable effect jobs; a provider data stream may instead declare resource scope and backpressure without order locks.
- pureTransitions:
  - compileConflictKeys(action, scope) -&gt; NonEmptyReadonlyArray&lt;ConflictKey&gt;：canonical 排序、去重并保留层级冲突关系。
  - claimJob(job, now, owner) -&gt; JobClaimed(epoch) | KeyConflict | LeaseNotExpired：只对已审批且已有 ExecutionReservation 的 Ready job claim；过期 worker 回写带 epoch，旧 epoch 永不能覆盖新 owner。
  - Closure rule: conflictsWith(a,b) -&gt; boolean uses the canonical hierarchy; acquireAll(sortedKeys) -&gt; AllKeys | LockConflict without partial ownership.
- effectBoundary: SQLite lock/job transaction 由 JournalWriter/Scheduler 实现；provider leaf handle 不管理业务 lock。STM 只保护本地 proposal view，不能替代 durable lock。
- durability: LogicalLocks 与 JobConflictKeys 在 prepare/claim/terminal transition 中有 FK/UNIQUE；Leased 必须 owner+epoch+deadline；RecoveryRequired 转 RecoveryCase 时锁 owner 转移而非按 tag 释放。 Closure rule: LogicalLocks and JobRunPermits persist canonical keys, owner variant and epoch; release is an atomic terminal-event operation.
- errors:
  - ConflictKeyHeld({ key, owner })：只阻塞相冲突 job，返回可重试/排队信息。
  - StaleLeaseEpoch({ jobId, expected, actual })：丢弃旧 worker 回写但可保存其 evidence。
  - RecoveryOwnershipRequired({ transactionId })：operator/recovery worker 接管前不允许新 mutation。
  - Closure rule: LockConflict
  - Closure rule: RecoveryCaseOwned
- preservedBehavior:
  - 同一 pending proposal 仍不允许同时被改写/执行。
  - 独立账户/instrument 的 work 可并行，这是对旧全局串行的有意改善。
- replacementSteps:
  - 删除 inflightWrite，迁移 add/commit guard 为 proposal revision 和 durable conflict keys。
  - 在 scheduler 中实现 SQL claim/fencing/recovery ownership。
  - 将测试由“第二 Promise 被拒绝”改为同 key exclusion、不同 key concurrency、lease expiry/restart。
- verificationCases:
  - AAPL job lease 过期而 worker 仍活着，新的 owner claim 成功；旧 worker 回写 Ack 不改变当前 attempt，只作为 late evidence。
  - AAPL 与 GOOG jobs 同时 claim 成功；两个 AAPL jobs 不能同时持有同一 Order/Exposure key。
  - Closure rule: Two unrelated scopes can claim concurrently; an Account lock blocks its declared child order/exposure work, and a failed multi-key claim leaves no partial lock.

- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: 对象级 inflightWrite 的全局串行是并发缺陷；目标把 ConflictKey/lease/fencing 限定于受控 effect jobs，provider 仍可为数据流使用自己的资源/背压模型。

  - [K12](../composition-contract.md)

Closure resolution: canonical ConflictKey parent/child relationships and atomic acquisition are fixed by the shared integration decision.

Contract alignment: Revision and approval binding wrap a declared controlled-effect leaf; a data capability never acquires this state merely because it has an identity.
- pureTransitions:
  - replaceDraft(state, expectedVersion, actions) -&gt; Accepted(DraftReplaced) | VersionConflict/InvalidActions：新 actions 不可修改已 prepared revision。
  - approve(state, revision, digest, actor, now) -&gt; Accepted(TransactionApproved) | ApprovalBindingMismatch | ApprovalExpired | Unauthorized：digest、revision、expiry、authorization 逐项检查，旧 hash 不作为唯一证明。
  - Closure rule: bindApproval(request, preparedPlan) -&gt; ApprovalBinding | StaleRevision | DigestMismatch; approval creates Queued only after the binding CAS succeeds.
- effectBoundary: application 收集 actor/authorization/policy/facts；JournalWriter 在一个 CAS transaction 中重读当前 version 并落 event/receipt；UI 只消费 PreparedPlanView，不直接持有 SDK action。
- durability: TransactionEvents UNIQUE(transactionId, aggregateVersion)，CommandReceipts UNIQUE(scope, commandId)；approval 和 StepQueued/EffectJob 同 commit，重启可见且不重建旧 hash。 Closure rule: ApprovalBinding and policy version are written with the approval event/receipt; replay never derives them from display text.
- errors:
  - VersionConflict({ expected, actual })：客户端刷新 draft，不执行 broker。
  - ApprovalBindingMismatch({ revision, digest })：拒绝旧审阅结果。
  - ApprovalExpired({ expiresAt, now })：回 Draft/PrepareRequired，不静默队列。
  - Closure rule: StaleRevision
  - Closure rule: DigestMismatch
  - Closure rule: ApprovalExpired
- preservedBehavior:
  - 审核期间禁止改变操作集合的语义保留，但由 durable revision/digest 实现。
  - 同一 command 重试保持幂等；对不同 payload 复用 commandId 返回 IdempotencyConflict。
- replacementSteps:
  - 把 add 改为 ReplaceDraft/append proposal view，移除对象级 PendingHashConflictError。
  - 把 commit 改为 Prepare；仅返回 serializable PreparedPlanView，不把 short hash 当执行 id。
  - 更新 HTTP/UI consumers 使用 transactionId/revision/digest/expiry，最后删除旧 hash guard。
- verificationCases:
  - 实例 A prepare revision 1 后实例 B replace draft 到 revision 2；A 用旧 hash/ digest approve 必须 VersionConflict/ApprovalBindingMismatch，broker dispatch 为 0。
  - 同一 transaction 的重复 Approve commandId 返回原 receipt，不追加第二组 jobs。
  - Closure rule: An approval with stale revision or digest is rejected before any EffectJob/DispatchStarted event, while actor and policyVersion survive replay.
- openQuestions: —
- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: pending hash 的对象内互斥被保留为 stale-review 风险证据；目标以 revision/digest/actor binding 保护受控效果，草稿和普通数据查询不获得 approval 能力。
- contractAnchors:
  - [K03](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K08](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K09](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K10](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K12](../composition-contract.md)

Stale approval cannot reach execution. Closure resolution: the field set is fixed by the shared protocol, while no native approval runtime is claimed.

- targetModel: Prepare 输入 DraftSnapshot + explicit AccountScope + scoped facts + immutable policy，输出 NonEmpty PreparedStepRecord（action-specific before-image、preconditions、ConflictKeys、CompensationAssessment、criterion）、FailurePolicy、expiry 和 canonical PlanDigest。Prepared 仅在 JournalWriter 原子持久化 TransactionPrepared 与 revision-scoped PreparedConflictLocks 后可见；此阶段绝不写 ExecutionReservation 或 EffectJob。Keyless/read-only input 只能形成 DraftReview/PreparationPreview，不能形成 executable PreparedPlan。 Closure rule: Prepare emits NativePlanRecord only after an adapter supplies versioned, serializable, reconstructible native evidence; otherwise Prepare returns PlanNotRecoverable/CapabilityUnavailable and no approval candidate. Contract alignment: Prepared plans are composed from the declared leaf schema and HOF components; the examples are not a kernel-wide order combination catalogue.
- pureTransitions:
  - compilePreparedPlan(actions, facts, policy, now) -&gt; Result&lt;PreparedPlanRecord, PrepareFailure&gt;：先逐 action resolve/assess，再校验非空、全 key 和 compensation policy，最后 canonical encode/digest。
  - validatePlanRecord(record) -&gt; Result&lt;PreparedPlanRecord, PlanDecodeFailure&gt;：运行时拒绝函数、SDK object、secret、未知字段和单位关系错误。
  - Closure rule: prepareNativePlan(action, adapterEvidence) -&gt; NativePlanRecord | PlanNotRecoverable | CapabilityUnavailable.
- effectBoundary: 事实读取（account/order/exposure/session/capability）在 application Effect 中；compiler 纯函数只接已解码 facts。JournalStore 负责写 PrepareStarted/TransactionPrepared 和 revision-scoped PreparedConflictLocks，不在长 SQL transaction 等 broker，也不创建 EffectJob/执行 reservation。 Closure rule: Native lookup and evidence collection stay in adapter effects; the pure compiler consumes normalized evidence and emits no SDK object.
- durability: PreparedPlanRecord 的 canonical bytes、encodingVersion、digest、revision、scope 与 before-image 一并存储；计划替换必须先以 CAS 退休旧 PreparedConflictLocks 再新 revision。任何 ExecutionReservation/EffectJob 只能由已审批且已提交的 plan digest 创建。 Closure rule: PreparedPlanRecord persists compiler/capability fingerprints and redacted serializable data; unsupported versions remain durable PlanVersionUnsupported.
- errors:
  - NothingToPrepare：draft action 为空，receipt 不生成 event。
  - PrepareFailure({ actionTag, issue })：逐 action 说明 capability/precondition/compensation/identity 缺口。
  - PlanNotSerializable({ fieldPath })：不允许将 SDK/函数/secret 带入 journal。
  - Closure rule: PlanNotRecoverable
  - Closure rule: CapabilityUnavailable
  - Closure rule: PlanVersionUnsupported
- preservedBehavior:
  - message 可作为审计元数据保留，但不再影响计划 identity 或授权。
  - 空 staging 仍应是明确业务拒绝而非崩溃 defect。
- replacementSteps:
  - 将 hash shape tests 改成 canonical digest/plan fields/encoding version 测试。
  - 添加 before-image、compensation assessment、criterion 和 FailurePolicy 的每 action fixture。
  - 删除基于 timestamp 的短 hash 作为 pending authority。
- verificationCases:
  - 同一 PreparedPlanRecord 以字段顺序不同输入 canonicalize 为同 digest；改变 quantity、policy 或 capability fingerprint 必须 digest 改变。
  - PlaceOrder 缺 instrument/account scope 或无法证明 plan 可重建：PrepareFailure/PlanNotRecoverable，绝不创建 dispatch job。
  - Closure rule: A broker without a reconstructible NativePlanRecord cannot reach Prepared/AwaitingApproval; its action remains non-executable DraftReview/PreparationPreview.
- openQuestions:
  - 每个 adapter 必须提供 NativePlanRecord 的 schema/compiler version、无 secret 的可重建证据和 capability fingerprint；未提供时 Prepare 返回 PlanNotRecoverable/CapabilityUnavailable，绝不把 action 送入 approval。
- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: 八字符 hash 不是 prepared plan；目标保留 source order terms 的精确性，但用 provider leaf schema/HOF 组合生成可序列化 plan，未声明的结构分支不出现。
- contractAnchors:
  - [K01](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K03](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K04](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K08](../composition-contract.md)
  - [K12](../composition-contract.md)
- review: accepted — The commit tests at TradingGit.spec.ts:111-131 treat an eight-character hash as preparation; the final Prepare contract writes a serializable plan and PreparedConflictLocks only, while ExecutionReservation/EffectJob are created only by approval. Closure resolution: adapter-specific NativePlanRecord schemas remain empirical; unproven reconstructibility safely blocks Prepare and approval.

### MAP-FE5C1D68F9

- mapping source: [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:389-406](../../../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts#L389-L406)

- assessment: designed
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:389-406: cancelOrder success=false 的 callback 结果进入 rejected 并暴露 error string。
- currentBehavior: 取消失败只有 action 字符串和错误文本；没有 cancellation target version、已有 fills、dispatch identity 或 unknown outcome。
- problem: cancel request 可能已被 venue 接收但响应丢失；NotFound 也不等价于未取消（订单可能已成交/不存在于当前命名空间）。字符串无法驱动安全 recovery。
- targetModel: PreparedCancelOrder 带 AccountScope、BrokerOrderId、OrderVersion、status/fills before-image；CancelAck 仅表示 request accepted/received，CancelObservation 区分 Cancelled、FilledLate、StillWorking、NotFoundAmbiguous、Unknown。补偿只针对已授权 exposure target，不假设可恢复原队列身份；keyless/read-only callers cannot prepare or dispatch a cancel。 Closure rule: NotFound is terminal only after adapter-provided complete scope/namespace, pagination/cursor and consistency evidence; otherwise classify NotFoundAmbiguous/ObserveUnknown and retain recovery. Contract alignment: Cancel evidence is modeled only when a provider declares a cancel leaf; absence and late-fill rules do not create a synthetic cancel command.
- pureTransitions:
  - interpretCancelOutcome(decoded) -&gt; CancelAck|CancelRejected|CancelUnknown：保留 order identity 和 response evidence。
  - settleCancel(before, observation) -&gt; CancelSettled|LateFillExposure|Reconciling：NotFound 未有 absence proof 时保持 Unknown。
  - Closure rule: classifyOrderAbsence(listingEvidence, byIdEvidence) -&gt; NotFoundWithEvidence | NotFoundAmbiguous | ObserveUnknown.
- effectBoundary: adapter 执行/观察 cancel；writer 记录 attempt/observation；transaction kernel 根据 criterion 和 fills 决定 terminal/abort。 Closure rule: Observation queries stay read-only; only normalized, evidence-bearing absence can enter a transaction criterion.
- durability: Cancel dispatch attempt 以 step/order/version 唯一；late fill 与 cancellation observation 进入同一 order projection 的版本序列，去重 native event identity。
- errors:
  - CancelRejected({ orderId, reason })：明确拒绝，按 policy 进入 abort/recovery。
  - CancelOutcomeUnknown({ dispatchId })：Observe only，不重复发送。
  - LateFillAfterCancel({ fillId, quantity })：追加 exposure/accounting evidence，不伪造 cancelled-only。
  - Closure rule: NotFoundAmbiguous
  - Closure rule: ObserveUnknown
  - Closure rule: RecoveryRequired
- preservedBehavior:
  - 明确 venue refusal 仍显示 cancel failed。
  - 成功 cancel request 未确认最终 order state 时不报告 completed cancellation，这是有意更正。
- replacementSteps:
  - 删除 cancel 的 generic OperationResult error path，加入 action-specific CancelAck/Observation schemas。
  - 把 CancelOrder 的 before-image/compensation assessment 纳入 prepare。
  - 迁移 failed-cancel test 覆盖 reject、unknown、already terminal 和 late fill。
- verificationCases:
  - timeout 后 broker ledger 已取消：重启 observe 得到 Cancelled，dispatch 次数保持 1。
  - cancel NotFound 但随后 order fill observation 到达：交易进入 late-fill/exposure path，不重复 cancel 或声称未发生。
  - Closure rule: An incomplete listing or uncertain ByIds response never produces terminal cancellation/rejection and schedules observation/reconciliation instead.
- openQuestions:
  - 只有 adapter 证明完整 namespace/scope、分页 cursor、最终一致性边界和 absence horizon 后 NotFound 才可终止；否则统一 NotFoundAmbiguous/ObserveUnknown，保留 recovery，不把空列表当 absence。
- contractDisposition: reframed
- contractRationale: cancel 的 NotFound 文本没有 absence 证据；目标保留 action-specific correlation 和 late-fill 事实，但 cancel 叶子只有在 provider capability 存在时才被发现。

## Cross-group contracts

- composition-contract.md K02/K03/K04：AccountScope 只适用于账户、订单、持仓、交易效果及其 observation/ConflictKey；公共 Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup 以自己的 declared data schema 表示，不凭空造 account/subAccount。单 wallet 只有在有证据时使用 SingleSubAccount，scope discovery 未完成则为 pending，不能用 undefined/空值。
- composition-contract.md K01/K02/K06/K07：CapabilityDescriptor 只固定协议版本、稳定能力身份、命令路径、schema/error/result、delivery/effect、权限/资源和 availability；provider 以声明树发布自己的叶子。不存在 global ActionContractMap，也不要求所有 provider 实现 Place/Modify/Cancel/Close 或返回 Unsupported。
- Schema 是声明源：静态 provider leaf 保留精确输入/输出/错误与原生扩展，动态边界用 JSON Schema/校验句柄；局部 union 与 HOF 可表达前置条件，不能把 provider extensions 降为 raw map 或手写订单笛卡尔积。
- Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup 与 TradingJournal 的 order/position/observation 都是语义数据单位；pull 是有限结果，push 是有生命周期/取消/背压/缺口的资源流，读、订阅、缓存和 accounting observation 不进入订单 prepare/approve/compensation。
- 只有声明受控交易效果的 capability 才可用 withTransaction；其 prepared payload、WAL/CAS/idempotency/lease/unknown/recovery/compensation 约束留在该效果路径。Prepare 只持有 revision-scoped locks，Approve/queue 才产生 execution reservations/jobs。
- Trigger source 与 authority 分离：被选中的数据事件只是 evidence；若策略是 ReturnToAgent，保留未发送 intent/evidence 并写 ReviewRequest/outbox，不创建 dispatch，回复必须是显式 Keep/Discard/Rearm/Revise/RequestSubmission command。
- GitAuditReader、order/accounting projections、simulation 与 export 都是可重建 read surfaces；projection lag、cache failure 或导出失败不能回滚远端效果或授权 retry。
- Native protocol、SDK、OpenAPI、独立进程和语言由 provider 自由选择；adapter 只在 UTA-facing boundary 做版本协商、schema decode、availability 与 evidence mapping，不能凭接口存在推导幂等、原子或补偿保证。
- TradingJournal 保留现有 WAL/CAS/idempotency、scope/unit validation、criterion、unknown-first reconciliation、RecoveryCase 与 migration evidence，但只在 controlled effect records 上使用，不把旧 IBKR/global switch 当 target contract。
- 没有生产迁移或 runtime proof；各条 source/native uncertainty 继续由 analyses 的 openQuestions 与 evidence retained，K12 组合实验需在实现 gate 用真实 provider process、持久 journal、独立 broker ledger 和负责 Session 验证。

## Additional findings

- services/uta/src/domain/trading/uta-manager.ts:61-77 仍在 initUTA 中 loadGitState 并注入 createGitPersister；cutover 必须等待 JournalStore startup/replay，再按 provider capability discovery 组装 application、scheduler 和 projections。
- services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:157-205 以 git.getPendingOrderIds 构造 broker getOrders、dispatcher switch Operation action 并把 callbacks 传给 TradingGit；这些实际 source edges 要拆成 declared leaf handles、durable order projection 与 JournalWriter，不能把 switch 复制到目标。
- services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:844-915 的 listing/per-order sync 把缺席订单当候选；listing completeness、namespace、cursor、finality 和 absence evidence 必须在 provider observation schema 中声明。
- services/uta/src/domain/trading/order-sync-poller.ts:4-16,53-90 以 timer、running boolean 和内存 pending scan 驱动 lanes；目标可把 cadence/backoff 作为 provider schedule/resource policy，但不能把 running guard 当 durable claim 或把每帧数据事务化。
- services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts:226-257,472-495,498-605 仍把 sync/simulate/push 与 string Error/regex mapper 暴露为 HTTP；routes 迁移要按 discovered leaf/query schema exhaustive map，不能用一个全局 command map或 message regex。
- services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1040-1105 的 wallet reconciliation 以 mark/avgCost 合成 reconcileBalance；目标保留 race guard，但把 provenance、currency/multiplier 和 uncertainty 放到 accounting observation，不生成 filled effect。
- services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:899-920 记录 multi-update sync 的 operations[1] boot-loop；逐 observation row 只修复 attribution，不把结果包装成订单事务。
- services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:856-897 记录 Alpaca bracket child 可能不在 open-orders listing；parent/TP/SL 的 durable references 与 availability evidence 必须保留，不因缺席推断 cancel/absence。
- services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:7-36 的 IBKR Contract/Order、sentinel 和 DERIVATIVE_SECTYPES 是当前 source coupling；它们必须保留为迁移事实与 adapter evidence，而不是要求所有 provider 模仿同一 SDK。
- K12 的 provider-field、absent-leaf、invalid-input、pull/push、foreign-output、ReturnToAgent 和 duplicate/late-reply/rearm scenarios 是目标 falsifiers；它们检验声明组合是否真的改变 metadata/CLI/schema，而非检验 MAP 行数。
